seed: A highlight used to be offered two rows one above the other, both called Outline. They painted different colours and both switches wrote the same ring, so picking either was a guess. This walk draws a highlight, then a rectangle, and reads what the Appearance list actually offers each of them.

steps.note: THE TEST: a lone highlight. The list must offer Color (its wash, no switch), one Outline (the ring, with a switch and a width) and Shadow. Two rows called Outline is the bug.
the one Outline switch, pressed: a real ring must appear round the highlight.
and pressed again: the ring goes, the wash stays.
the regression check: a rectangle still offers Fill, Outline and Shadow, its Outline still carrying the width.
